review_notes: Scope is the current arm64/macOS release inputs. A changed crate, source, toolchain, SDK, native library or architecture requires recollection and review.
17 application crate records rely on actual upstream SPDX declarations plus original source packages and separately labeled canonical terms. No missing copyright attribution was invented.
Native licenses selected: MPL-2.0 for both Wooting SDKs, BSD-3-Clause alternative for hidapi, LGPL-2.1-or-later for libusb. Full native corresponding-source archives accompany notices.

Analog SDK correspondence is established by exact official release-archive/member identity, clean tag, lockfile, workflow, and observed binary version paths. This is not a byte-reproducible-build proof.
A modified libusb was rebuilt, substituted in an isolated app copy, ad-hoc signed, and its version marker read with libusb_get_version without USB initialization. Original app remained unchanged.

Public Xcode agreement EA2002 (06/08/2026) permits compliant macOS app/library distribution in section 2.4 but reserves Apple Software rights in sections 2.6-2.7. It does not explicitly resolve the upstream generated-binding caveat; it is not evidence of the exact agreement accepted for the installed command-line tools.
